title: R2 fixes: build system (BUILD_CRYPTO2DEVTEST, crypto2devsim option)
description:
Three build system fixes:
1. Add AM_CONDITIONAL([BUILD_CRYPTO2DEVTEST], [test x$ENABLED_CRYPTO2DEVTEST = xyes]) to configure.ac
2. Move crypto2dev_test.c into nested 'if BUILD_CRYPTO2DEVTEST' block within include.am (currently compiled unconditionally within BUILD_CRYPTO2DEV)
3. Add --enable-crypto2devsim configure option that sets -DWOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_SIM (currently users must manually pass CFLAGS)
